summary:
For someone in Turks And Caicos Islands, the three needs areas with the largest gaps are: mobility (0.34), food (0.47), environment (0.50).
The three strongest areas are: health (0.78), agency (0.77), governance (0.71).
Personal-agent suggestions: focus community-building energy on weakest categories; leverage strongest categories as sources of economic value to bring to the community.
